# StatOz design tokens

<!-- Generated by `npm run design:sync` from src/domain/brand-guide.ts and the stylesheets. Do not edit by hand. -->

Values are resolved from `src/design-system/styles/tokens.css` and `src/features/compositions/composition.css`. In code, always use the token name (`var(--ds-…)`), never the value.

## Principles

- **Dark and calm.** Dark navy surfaces, white type, muted blue-grey support. Atmosphere comes from the calm grid and scanlines, never film grain or noise.
- **One signal.** Cyan is the identity and the interactive signal. Other accents carry a meaning (sport, reward, danger, elite) and are never decoration.
- **Glow is scarce.** Only one focal element glows: the selected action, the live state, or the reveal moment. Static panels, rows and secondary chips stay flat.
- **Every edge has intent.** Surfaces are chamfered plates with a continuous outline around the whole silhouette. No rounded Material cards, no pill-heavy UI, no generic white cards.
- **Display for identity, body for detail.** Orbitron carries headlines, numbers and the brand; Onest carries body copy and controls. Changing numbers use tabular figures.

## Shape and surface

| Shape | Clip-path token | Cut | Use |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| HUD panel | `--ds-clip-hud` | `--ds-shape-hud-cut` = 14px | Standard plates and HudPanel: a large top-left/bottom-right cut with small opposing accents. |
| Compact HUD | `--ds-clip-compact-hud` | `--ds-shape-compact-hud-cut` = 12px | Dense rows and small tiles. |
| Panel | `--ds-clip-panel` | `--ds-shape-panel-cut` = 12px | Symmetric containers and dialogs. |
| Signal plate | `--ds-clip-signal` | `--ds-shape-signal-cut` = 12px | Callouts with a notched signal step on the top edge. |
| Collectible card | `--ds-clip-card` | `--ds-card-cut-big` = 14px | PlayerCard and ActionCard silhouettes. Resized cards compute their cuts with cardCuts(width) from tokens/shape.ts. |
| Chip | `--ds-clip-chip` | – | FilterChips plates and compact tags. |
| Field | `--ds-clip-field` | `--ds-shape-field-cut` = 10px | Inputs and selects. |
| Tab plate | `--ds-clip-tab-plate` | `--ds-shape-tab-chamfer` = 16px | Raised active tabs; bottom corners cut only. |

- Draw a chamfered surface as two layers with the same clip-path: an outer shell in the border color and an inner fill inset by 1px. A normal CSS border does not follow a clip-path.
- Keep the outline continuous around every cut corner at every breakpoint and state.
- Glow is an accent at about 30% alpha: glow() from design-system/tokens/elevation.ts on unclipped elements, or a drop-shadow on the unclipped element around a clipped plate. A clip-path cuts away any shadow cast by the clipped layer itself. One glowing element per surface.
- Depth for the rest comes from the surface ladder (muted, primary, secondary, elevated) and border strength, not drop shadows.

## Layout and motion

| Format | Canvas | Safe area | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Square (1:1) | 1080×1080 | 8% on all sides | Keep the logo and CTA inside the guide. |
| Portrait feed (4:5) | 1080×1350 | 8% on all sides | The default feed ratio. |
| Reels / Shorts (9:16) | 1080×1920 | 14% top · 14% right · 22% bottom · 8% left | Platform UI covers the top, the right rail and the caption area. |
| Landscape (16:9) | 1920×1080 | 8% on all sides | Use the width: split layouts beat centred stacks. |

Safe areas are house guides, not official platform compliance guarantees.

- Video briefs run 8–60 seconds and render at 30 fps. Motion is a function of frame time, so preview and export match.
- Entries ease out (cubic, about 0.5 s); exits fade quickly (about 0.25 s). Use step, easeOut and smoothstep from src/features/compositions/motion.ts.
- Structure: an immediate hook, a concise reveal, a payoff, then a StatOz CTA that reads with the sound off.
- Keep each line on screen long enough to read twice. No flashes, no strobing, no hard cuts on text.
- Respect prefers-reduced-motion in studio UI.
- Feedback has a hierarchy (card_game): a subtle selection tick, an impact confirmation, the round result, the settlement reveal, then the rare celebration. Save the biggest beat for genuinely scarce outcomes.
- Actions answer a press at once: hover lifts 1px, press returns to rest or scales to 0.96, and the hero CTA breathes its halo on a 1.8 s loop that reduced motion stills.
- Reduced motion removes shake, trails, repeated pulses and long staging, but keeps every score, verdict and reward readable.
